doc: docs/PORT_PLAN.md 2.3: the reviewed patch list (dest file -> exact old/new pairs, applied after the rewrite rules). Six or fewer files; a seventh is a question for the owner, not a commit. Layout B (mirror, parent decision 2026-10-22) makes the plan's camera.py data-root patch unnecessary: vsbench/ is the copy's repository root, so vs-sim's own REPO_ROOT = parents[1] already lands on vsbench/configs, vsbench/benchmark, vsbench/assets.

patches.reason: the package-hygiene test names the package by its import name; here that is vsbench (vsbench.vs), not vssim

the fresh-interpreter no-torch check imports the copy (vsbench.vs), the module that exists here

pairs.reason: there is no module vssim here; fromlist makes __import__ return vsbench.vs itself (not the top package vsbench); the record key stays vssim_version (schema data)

porcelain paths are relative to the repository top (vsbench/x), but dirty_paths filters them against REPO_ROOT = vsbench/; --short prints them relative to git -C REPO_ROOT (x, ../y) in the same two-column format, so the experiments/ filter works in the nested copy; the whole tree is still reported. The four -c settings pin what --short prints against a user's git config (status.relativePaths=false would print top-relative paths again; status.branch=true / status.showStash=true would add a '## branch' / stash line that _parse_porcelain would read as a path); color.status=false keeps escape codes out
